title: Produce rating component audit sheet
description: Audit the rating filter as an individual component or explicitly classify it as an option-family variant before adding controls.
objective: Resolve rating anatomy, threshold semantics, icon strategy, states, responsive behavior, and control backlog.
acceptance_criteria: Rating options, threshold semantics, star/icon/numeric labels, selected state, hover, focus, disabled, and responsive behavior are treated as separate subelements.
Rating is classified as its own type or as an option-family variant with a clear reason.
The audit does not implement rating fixes yet.
verification: No plugin source changes are made.

budgets.context_budget: rating render, option parser, option CSS, frontend JS

risks: Rating can duplicate radio or chips behavior if classification stays vague.
Icon strategy can become visual polish without a filtering contract.
